buildSourceNote: Build 134 carries v1.1.0-rc.10, the third defect found on the same live journey (rc.8 = the stage change never reached the screen, rc.9 = the advisor could not compile, rc.10 = the billing queue threw 500 for everyone). The advisor acknowledged the QC pass and recorded the Rs.2000 estimate; GET /api/billing/ready-from-qc listed the vehicle and POST /api/billing/pre-invoice/check-readiness/7386 answered { ready: true, blockers: [] } - every engine gate clear - but the Compile button could only ever answer 403. All five routes the advisor's own screen calls (compile, review, send-to-customer, capture-confirmation, handoff) were authorize("billing", "edit"), and service_advisor holds Billing with can_view 1 / can_edit 0. Billing.edit could not simply be granted instead: it also gates crm-invoice and manual-gate-pass/:mgpId/gm-action, so an advisor could approve a Manual Gate Pass and release a vehicle, contradicting the 2026-09-14 settlement rule. Migration 031 therefore creates module PRE_INVOICE and grants it to service_advisor (plus billing, cashier and gm_service, which already had the capability via Billing.edit), and the five routes are re-gated onto it. Also noted, since RESOLVED by the owner: Abdul Qadeer (dev-207) is the biller, and he existed with user_role BILLER, which is not a role in the roles table, so he resolved to ZERO permissions - a biller who could not bill. The owner reassigned him to 'billing'. rc.10 itself fixes GET /api/billing/my-queue, which returned 500 for every caller: getBillingQueue() compared a bare CAST(pi.pre_invoice_id AS CHAR), which takes the CONNECTION collation, against the utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci column tbl_handoff_sla.entity_id, raising ER_CANT_AGGREGATE_2COLLATIONS. The Billing screen renders

on failure, and because tbl_pre_invoice was genuinely empty too, the broken state looked correct - it would have stayed 'correct' straight through the first real handoff. The same file already carried the right form in checkPhase8Readiness(). Proved against production before deploying (old query -> error, new query -> 0 rows) and verified live after (200 as dev-207). See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
